name: Philippines
change_summary: The base law: SSS 15% under RA 11199 with Circular 2024-006, SSS_EC ₱30, PhilHealth 5% between ₱10,000 and ₱100,000, HDMF 2%/2% on a ₱10,000 fund salary, the TRAIN withholding table, the Labor Code working-time rules and the statutory leave types. No later change of law moves a seeded value (RR 29-2025 and the wage orders touch unmodelled caps — see the lineage README).

limits.authority: Labor Code of the Philippines art.83

night_premium.ordinary_add: rest_day && day_type == "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" ? 26.0 : rest_day && day_type == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" ? 15.0 : rest_day || day_type == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" ? 13.0 : day_type == "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" ? 20.0 : 10.0
night_premium.overtime_add: rest_day && day_type == "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" ? 33.8 : rest_day && day_type == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" ? 19.5 : rest_day || day_type == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" ? 16.9 : day_type == "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" ? 26.0 : 12.5

work_rules.authority: Labor Code of the Philippines (P.D. 442, as amended) Book III: art.82 (coverage), art.83 (eight-hour day), art.85 (meal period), art.86 (night shift differential), art.87 (overtime), art.91 (weekly rest day), art.93 (rest-day premium) and art.94 (holiday pay), with Proclamation No. 1006, s.2025 for the 2026 regular holidays and special (non-working) days. Applied 2026-09-18 (2): art.86 and Handbook ch.5: the night shift differential is 10% of the hour’s own rate, so 13 on a rest day or a special day, 20 on a regular holiday, 26 on a regular holiday falling on the rest day, 15 on a special day on the rest day, and on the overtime hours of each 12.5, 16.9, 26, 33.8 and 19.5 (`night_premium` adds as expressions over the day; the first eight night hours of a rest day or holiday are its ordinary ones). Handbook ch.2 §E: a monthly-paid employee (`payroll_group` MONTHLY) is prorated and has an absence deducted on the 365 factor, 30.4167 a month (`proration_by`); the daily-paid keep 21.75 or 26.0833. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): The night-differential ladder reads the day type (`day_type`, which the holiday takes under `holiday_rest_precedence: PUBLIC_HOLIDAY`); `holiday.kind` is the published row’s kind (PUBLIC | SPECIAL | SUBSTITUTE), and a day-type literal against it never matched.

wages.authority: Applied 2026-09-18 (2): the wage orders state a daily rate; `by_region` carries it × 313/12 and `wages.scale` restates the floor on the person’s own factor — 365/12 for the monthly-paid, 261/12 on a five-day week, 313/12 on a six-day one — and the apprentice’s 75% (RA 6727; Labor Code arts.61, 75). Applied 2026-09-19 (3): Wage Order No. IVA-22 (effective 5 Oct 2025; nwpc.dole.gov.ph/region-iva): non-agriculture ₱600 in the Extended Metropolitan Area and the component cities (`IV-A`), ₱550 in 1st-class municipalities, ₱510 in reclassified 1st-class and 2nd–5th-class municipalities, the last two stepping to ₱550 and ₱525 on 1 April 2026 — the version from that date carries the second tranche. Each figure is the daily rate × 313 ÷ 12.

encashment.day_amount: terms.pay_frequency == "DAILY" ? terms.basic_salary : terms.pay_frequency == "HOURLY" ? terms.basic_salary * terms.ordinary_hours_per_week / terms.working_days_per_week : terms.basic_salary / (terms.payroll_group == "MONTHLY" ? 365.0 / 12.0 : (terms.working_days_per_week >= 6.0 ? 313.0 : 261.0) / 12.0)
encashment.authority: DOLE Handbook on Workers Statutory Monetary Benefits, Service Incentive Leave, Conversion: salary rate on the conversion date, with pro-rata conversion. A daily contract supplies its daily salary; an hourly contract uses its normal scheduled hours per workday. Monthly equivalent factors follow paid-day coverage. Standing allowances require express basic-salary classification. https://nwpc.dole.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/2023-07-25-Handbook-on-Workers-Statutory-Monetary-Benefits-2023_edition.pdf

sources.instructions:
Sources are the primary instrument first — the statute or regulation in the national law database, the gazette, or the table the authority itself publishes — one page per fact the version seals, never a news article or a commentary. A historical version lists the instruments in force on its own effective date. Where the primary host refuses the reader (sso.agc.gov.sg, officialgazette.gov.ph, peraturan.bpk.go.id, kwsp.gov.my, hrdcorp.gov.my answer 403 to Norbital-Public-Page-Reader) the authority’s own published table is listed instead, or the Wayback Machine’s dated copy of the authority’s own page or PDF (web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<url>) — never a host the reader cannot open.
officialgazette.gov.ph — the Official Gazette: Republic Acts, proclamations, executive orders. A proclamation is /<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/proclamation-no-<n>-s-<year>/ (HTML, full text); /section/proclamations/ lists the newest first; /nationwide-holidays/<year>/ is the holiday calendar. lawphil.net mirrors the same texts and is corroboration only.
sss.gov.ph — /pay-contribution/ carries the contribution schedule (the 2025 table PDF under /wp-content/uploads/ is 6.3 MB, over the reader limit: read the HTML page); /sss-circulars/ lists circulars by year.
philhealth.gov.ph — /advisories/<year>/ lists advisories; each is /advisories/<year>/PA<year>-<nnnn>.pdf (small, text). /partners/employers/ContributionTable_v2.pdf is the premium table.
pagibigfund.gov.ph — Circular 460 at /document/pdf/circulars/provident/Circular No. 460 - Guidelines on the Pag-IBIG Fund… (1.9 MB, text): the 1%/2% tiers and the ₱10,000 fund salary cap.
bir.gov.ph — bir-cdn.bir.gov.ph/local/pdf/Annex E RR 11-2018.pdf is the withholding table (monthly and semi-monthly columns, 0.3 MB); revenue regulation digests are under bir-cdn.bir.gov.ph/BIR/pdf/.
nwpc.dole.gov.ph — regional wage orders: /ncr/, /region-iva/ (and the other regions); /bwc-handbook-workers-statutory-monetary-benefits/ is the DOLE Handbook (factors, premiums, 13th month).
pco.gov.ph answers 403 to the reader; use the Gazette.

name: Philippines
change_summary: No change of law. This version exists to carry the STATUTORY_ADJUSTMENT payment code the company records name from January 2026; every statutory row is a clone of the 2025-12-01 version. The next change of law (a 2027 wage order, an SSS or PhilHealth circular) is a new version from its own date.
